layout.note: the layout check (ui/specs/layout.mjs): today's values (the stage kind and the opening of C1, the painted window), with `reserved` (a coming-out silhouette on its drop spot) placed by depth beside the room's pieces; `given` names the props the check reads as the frame's facts: `view` (room, house or tucked: L10c runs on a room-view frame only) and `regions.window.edge` (the room's crop, its painting's size, its keep boxes and its joins in painting coordinates). `resident` is not a mover: the owner's grid rulings depend on it

status: The layout spec for the Vivarium, rewritten in place for the collection v2 design: one screen with three fields (the room view, the house view, the Tucked away page), the chip row and the card. Every drawn region names its word or composition; the states, the views, the focus as data, the events, the bottom line, the strings and the masters
note: The one home of the numbers of the Vivarium (the collection v2 design §1 to §8). Rectangles are [x, y, w, h] in screen pixels at 1024 x 600; `at` offsets are from the region's own origin; `painting` marks rooms.json's 1024 x 568 painting coordinates. One screen, three fields: the chip row and the card never move, only the field changes (the room's painting, the cold recess, or five bands). The mibis keep walking, resting and climbing as built; only a carried mibi pauses. Its closer level is one mibi up close (habitat.json).
purpose: Every mibi of the player in one place: the room shown alive in its window at one scale, the house view of every room and the store, and the card of the one under the ring with its six plates. The player sees who is where, moves a mibi by picking it up and setting it down, swaps, tucks away and brings out, takes along and brings home, starts the pick of two, and looks closer, each with one press. Reads first: the mibis in the room; then the card

notes.motion: Reduced motion (props.motion false; UI designer, 2026-10-10 02:29): every event on this screen is a cut to its end, so the host sends hold 0 and runs what follows an event's end (a hand-off, a jump, the next state) on the frame of the key; nothing waits on a still frame. look and back are cuts to the other level. A press that ends an event with `cut: true` also acts (habitat.json notes.cut); no event here cuts. The lift, the flip and the set-down are cuts with reduced motion; the walk keeps today's cut rules.
notes.painting: the room view shows a 688 x 472 window of the room's own 1024 x 568 painting at 1:1, at rooms.json `crop` [cx, 96] (cx 0, 176, 178 and 152): screen = painting − (cx, 8); one painting a light, never cropped and enlarged
notes.edge: the owner's rule of 2026-10-29 14:38, verbatim: "the window edge never cuts through a mibi, the nest, or a key prop like the tree or the burrow. It may cut plain background such as grass, sky or wall." Every placed figure keeps its ink at least 8 px inside the window (the walk's clamp, the drop spots); the bed, every piece left in the view, every join and every key prop (rooms.json `keep`) are wholly inside; a keep box may cross only on its `leaves` side where it reaches the painting's edge (15:24: the trees' tops in Roots and Boulders). A rester leaving and a mibi walking in cross the left edge in motion only. L10c checks it on every room-view frame
notes.scale: one factor a view, the same for every mibi and every species, never a fit and never an upscale (stand-sizes.json): the room view and the Tucked away page 96/304 (a 96 x 99 picture standing in the 96 x 96 place), the house view 48/304 (48 x 50), the card 144/304 (144 x 148). A species with a layered stand is composed at the factor in the logic process; every other species' signed 304 x 312 stand is reduced by the factor. The moving sets' atlases are at Home's world size: at the room view's factor a mibi walks as its stand translated along its path, as a layered stand does on Home, until its atlases are cut at the factor
notes.nothing else: no words in the field but the focused mibi's name tag and the house view's band names; the card is the only place with words about a mibi; nothing reads as rows
notes.residents: the room view draws the mibis present in the room, as today: at most rules.show.max walk, the rest rest (rules.show), on the bed (Roots) or curled, or walk out by main's left end through the window's left edge; travellers are not drawn (R4b); a mibi coming out stands as its reserved silhouette on its drop spot. The house view draws everyone, travellers and the tucked away included
notes.paintingLands: a painting that lands while its mibi is on screen waits for the next fresh draw (the whole opened again, a wake): never a swap in view

rules.closedList: station-layouts.md, The derived rules (closed): railCompaction slantTabs pageGrid platePosition listPitch splicePlan guideColumns pipGroups leafArc
rules.listPitch: the rooms pane's chips (regions.chips.forms: n chips, 1 to 4) and the places pane's tiles (regions.tiles.forms: eight places), each by the form with the smallest upTo at least n

travel.note: G10 (game-design.md, Reconciled): N = the awake, unfocused moving residents; on each group tick a resident whose rest has run out starts, longest rest first, while travelling < min(max, max(capMin, ⌈N/capDiv⌉)), max the ceiling (the game designer: 2 moving at once; the stills count too); then, while travelling < ⌈N/floorDiv⌉, one that has rested ≥ minRest ticks starts, and never above the ceiling; ≤ airborne in the air at once; the face reads these for Home, Idle and the whole (one place, one rule)

walk.note: the walk on the rooms' levels (arch-rooms.md §2; the game designer, gd-age-rooms.md Part 2): at most max(1, ⌊N/raisedDiv⌋) residents on the raised levels, N the residents shown, 1 trip in levelOneIn changes level when the cap allows; speed[stage] = [px, own ticks of 80 ms] along the major axis: a juvenile 2 px a tick, an adult 1, an elder 1 every 2

night.note: G7 in own ticks (80 ms): one stir every stir[0]–stir[1] across the household while one is asleep, never a focused sleeper, never in the afterCurl ticks after its own curl, never the last one twice, none while one wanders; when every resident is asleep, one wakes every wander[0]–wander[1] from the end of the last curl (juveniles first, then adults, never an elder, never the last one twice), travels to 1–2 waypoints each ≤ reach px away, rests breathing until awake[0]–awake[1] after its wake (at least two breaths) and curls where it stands; its rest is never written

rest.note: the game designer's R1 (Station M1): each sleep group settles and wakes across a windowS window from the light change, one resident at a time, member k of n at window start + ⌊k·W/n⌋ + (seed mod max(1, ⌊W/(2n)⌋)) s; restOf (views/home-props.mjs) is the only reader, the face sees `rest`

curl.gapRule: ink to ink: |xA - xB| >= ceil(inkA.w/2) + ceil(inkB.w/2) + gap, the measured curl ink (<= 96 wide, so <= 144 between feet); the same against the bed's rect

show.bed: nappers: the bed's places are for resters only; the carried set is never drawn in a room (rules.show.travellers)

travellers.return: on leaving the carried set (the Companion's home at a dock): roomSince = now, it walks in from rooms.json rest.edge (reduced motion: a cut to its walk start) and is fresh (pin)
travellers.rail: its place stays in the rail with the away mark (regions.tiles.tile.travellerGlyph) and its card opens with every action held (habitat.json stateRule)

show.note: the game designer's R4b with the owner's cats (the R4b rest rules): at most max residents shown per room on the whole and Idle (Home: min(max, what fits at 1x)), the always-shown counted inside max. Pinned first, in pin order: the focused mibi, ui.meet, then the fresh (roomSince descending, then id), up to max. Every other resident ranks by: its sleep group in its night (settle[group] to wake[group] of rules.rest, wrapping midnight; the group as restOf's) before its day, then stage in rest order, then born ascending, then id; the first (n - max) of that order rest. Fresh: roomSince is set and now is before the first settle[group] time at least freshMinS after roomSince. A rester finishes its trip (leg 2 included), then rests at the first of where: the bed (a free place, in rest order; the carried set is never drawn, rules.show.travellers), the room's art spot (rooms.json rest.spots), else its own way: curl when hash(id) mod 100 < curl.pct[stage], else out. curl: a nice spot (a valid walk target on the level it is on, curl ink >= gap from every curl and the bed's rect; beside an occluder at x = rect.x - beside or rect.x + rect.w + beside, y = foot - occDy; or at a level x breakpoint, y = top(x) + backDy), seeded by id within rules.night.reach, else the nearest valid one, else where it stands if valid; while fewer than curl.max resters are curled off the bed in the room, else out. out: rooms.json rest.edge. A mibi with no curl picture (nap master or moving nap) always goes out. The walk to rest is a trip under rules.travel.max. Resters are shown false wherever they lie and never count toward max. A shown one comes back from its rest place; an asleep one waits for its own wake flip unless focused (then it walks out and curls at its first waypoint, as G7's wanderer). On a fresh show resters start at rest. G7's wander and stirs take only shown residents (a curled rester may stir in place). N for rules.walk's raised cap and for G10 counts only shown residents

panel.from: ✓ on the Add a room chip or the house view's next-room band: addRoom (nothing is spent until a card is pressed; short of Energy the Add the room card is dimmed and says what is short); ✓ on the card's live Return plate: today's confirming panel (wildMibi)
panel.closes: Not now, ← or a room key: the Vivarium as before, nothing spent; Add the room: the room is added, shown empty with the ring on its chip, and the plate says it is ready; Return: the mibi goes back to the wild and the ring goes to the nearest mibi of the room, else its chip

views.room: the room view: the room's painting in the window, its present mibis walking (§3); the chip under the ring or the lit chip names the room
views.house: the house view: five slate bands, the rooms bought, the next room, the later rooms, Tucked away (§5)
views.tucked: the Tucked away page: the cold recess, its rails, eight tucked mibis a page (§3)

conditions.docked: the Companion in the Caddy: the carried mibis are not drawn in the room; in the house view they keep their place, darkened x 0.55, with the solid Companion mark
conditions.away: the Companion out: the carried mibis are not drawn in the room; in the house view they keep their place, darkened x 0.55, with the outline Companion mark
conditions.dock: Dock while the Vivarium shows: nothing in the room moves; the house view's marks cut between outline and solid on the frame of the world event

initial: by the save: no housed mibi, empty; else rest
stateRule: rest: at least one mibi housed in the room shown (at home, out with the Companion, or coming out). empty: no mibi housed in the room shown (the Vivarium may still have one elsewhere): the window with the room's painting (Roots: the empty bed at the window's centre), the chip row and the card. The house view and the Tucked away page have the same states by the room shown

stage.note: the stage's ground shows round the window and the card (x 688 to 704, y 560 to 562)

painting.source: the room's own painting of the light (rooms.json rooms.<id>.base)
painting.rule: a 688 x 472 window of the 1024 x 568 painting at 1:1: screen = painting − (cx, 8)

edge.fact: props regions.window.edge: { crop, painting, keep, joins } for the layout check (L10c)

window.until: the placeholder: back `forest`, ground band `clay` with a `sand` top row, foot `soil`
window.note: the field: still on the screen's left edge (vivarium-L2-1, a window to the environment); no bezel; no words inside but the focused mibi's name tag
window.slice: the room's painting, its window at the crop

walk.box: the figure's box x within 8 .. 680 − W (its ink 8 px inside the window: the clamp, the foot point within [cx + 8 + L, cx + 680 − R]), feetY on the room's levels moved to the window (painting − (cx, 8)); a join is taken only when the figure stands whole at both its ends
walk.keepOutRule: a walker's foot point (F.x, feetY) meets K exactly when K.x <= F.x < K.x + K.w and feetY > K.y: K is the bed's span, from the top of the tallest measured curl on the bed (footY − curlH) to the window's foot, so that no walker stands among the sleepers; derived by station/tools/make-keepout.mjs from the measured curls (and checked), never typed
walk.start: one draw r: the level (1 start in rules.walk.levelOneIn on a raised level while the raised cap allows), then room_point on it (⌈w/4⌉ inside each end), up to 8 draws, off keepOut; fallback main's leftmost point at its top
walk.waypoint: one draw for the level (1 trip in levelOneIn changes level through a join, cap allowing), then room_point on the target level; rejected if max(|dx|,|dy|) < 32 or the path leaves the level or meets a keep-out; a change of level is the three legs of arch-rooms §2.2; after 8 rejections, idle again
walk.rule: each walks with its feet on the room's levels inside the clamp; Boulders' ramp top and terrace lie outside every figure's clamp, so no Boulders walker climbs in the room view

resident.order: by the feet's y, lower in front (drawn later), left first on a tie; the bed and its sleepers sort as one, at the bed's foot (y 544); the focus set (the focused mibi, Home's met one) is drawn after every other resident and piece, in the slot order ring, picture, mark disc, name tag. A walker may pass in front of it by depth and is drawn under it; walkers do not avoid it.

asleep.when: clip curl, asleep or stir; walker form in wake, breathe, hop, walk; a one-shot under way when focus lands shows its end state's form

asleep.ring: feet form on the ink box: [x + w/2 − 56, feet − 12, 112, 24]
asleep.tag: over the ink: top feet − 120, centred on x + w/2, slid 8 px inside the window, no lift
asleep.target: the resident's box [x, feet − h, w, h], unchanged
asleep.order: by feet as a walker; in the slot: shadow, ring, picture, dither, lamp
asleep.spot: [x + w/2 − 56, feet − 12, 112, 24]: no other resident's waypoint or start point has its ground point in it
asleep.focus: no curl, wake, stir or wander begins while focused; a due change starts when focus leaves; a carried sleeper stays curled and curls where it is set down

carry.silhouette: the 1 px `fog` outline of the figure at the point it left (the outline picture of its stand)
carry.rule: ✓ on a mibi or on Move pauses it alone where it stands; it rises 8 px with its ring and is drawn after everyone over the hand's target; every other mibi keeps walking. ✓ sets it down (it resumes from where it stands); ← puts it back at the point it left

mark.at: [ink right − 14, ink top − 8, 20, 20]: centred on (ink right − 4, ink top + 2) of the drawn figure's ink, clamped inside the window, lifted with the figure

resident.props: per resident: mibi id, stage, picture at 96/304 and its figure, waiting, seed, mark; the face steps the walk, as on Home and Idle; the focused one keeps walking (lift 0)

ink.rule: the nap pose's ink is at most 96 wide and 88 tall, centred on footX and bottom-aligned on footY: at most [footX − 48, 455, 96, 88]; three sit on the 192 px bed (248 to 440)

sleepers.focus: each sleeper is a resident target, with the feet ring and no lift

states.empty: the nest drawn empty at the bed's rect (rim bark, hollow soil, lit rim sand), no sleeper and no mark; not a target
states.resting: one to three resters on it in rest order at places[n], drawn as sleepers (nap curl, ring if focused, no lift); each is a resident target

bed.note: Roots' bed at the window's centre (rooms.json rooms.roots.bed [248, 496, 192, 56], foot 551, painting): the same place on Idle and here, moved by (0, 8); the other rooms have none

nameTag.when: a resident or a sleeper is focused; never otherwise
nameTag.w: the name's width + 16, rounded up to 8, at least 48; the widest name (160 px at 16) gives 176
nameTag.y: top at feetY + 16, under the ring; if its bottom would pass y 552 (8 px inside the window), it sits over the figure: top = feetY − H − 32 − lift; a sleeper's tag is always over its curl: top = ink top − 32, no lift
nameTag.x: centred on the resident's box, slid to stay 8 px inside the window (8 to 680)
nameTag.note: Home's tag (home.json regions.nameTag), the same size; it follows the walker

rooms.note: the chip row: a chip a room bought, then Add a room while a room can be added, at [16 + 136i, 48, 128, 32]; All rooms at [560, 48, 128, 32]; and Tucked away at [704, 48, 304, 32] over the card. The lit chip names the view; the ring on a chip shows its view (the room, the house, the cold page)

name.note: 14 px bone, its line centred in the chip

underline.note: the lit chip: a 2 px bone underline at y 80, its width

name.rule: 16 px bone; 14 px when it does not fit; never clipped

card.empty: No mibis yet, one plate Go to the Incubator with the ring on it
card.note: the only place with words about a mibi: the focused mibi only, a slate pane with the 1 px top-left bevel, no rows or hairlines

house.marks: travellers darkened x 0.55 with the Companion disc; coming out the `fog` silhouette and the lamp; the disc rides the figure as in the room view, [ink right − 14, ink top − 8, 20, 20], clamped inside the tile
house.focus: the feet ring at 1/2 (the room view's ring on the figure's own width) and the name tag under it
house.note: the whole house at a glance: the four rooms as four windows, each at half the room view (the build's sign-off, replacing §5's bands). Rooms not bought: the next room's tile at x 0.55 with the plate Add a room ⚡p (a target: ✓ opens the panel); later rooms at x 0.55, their name in `fog`, not a target. Tucked away is its own page behind its chip

tucked.note: the cold recess: no painting, no walking (the clocks are stopped); 8 a page, 4 to a rail, each figure at 96/304 on its rail in the cold veil palette; more pages with pips, ◀▶ with nothing beyond flips

marks.rule: one mark a mibi, the first that applies (the Companion marks in the house view only); the room view's disc rides the figure's ink; the house view's sits on the ring's top-right corner, drawn after the ring; the card's state line uses the same master with no disc

drawOrder: window (the painting, the cold recess or the bands)
residents, the bed, reserved silhouettes and the room's occluders (by the feet's y)
the focus set (ring, picture, mark disc, name tag; a carried mibi raised over the hand's target)

look.do: ✓ Look on the card: the frame's screen transition to one mibi up close (habitat.json), that mibi shown, the ring on it

swap.do: the ring moved to a room's chip (or a room was added, or a carry flipped to another room): the room shown is now that room (st.face.room, set by the host) and the window cross-dithers to it from the old room's painting (the event's from); the chips, the card and the line are cuts on the frame of the key

focus.room: the ring on nothing only when the Vivarium has no mibi and no Go to the Incubator plate (never: the empty card's plate takes it)

entry.homePanel: Home's ✓ Open the Vivarium: the room view of the room of the mibi last seen up close (st.face.room), the ring on that mibi; none there, the room's first present mibi; an empty room, its chip; no mibi at all, the card's Go to the Incubator plate

selectors.plate.first: the card's first live plate (Look, unless held), else the first plate
selectors.card.of: the card's mibi's own target in the field wherever it now stands (its resident, its house place, its cold box), else the lit chip
